scope: Multi-site content extraction and catalog compatibility in the local cloud instance.

syntheticLayouts: public Next.js chapter JSON and JSON-LD
syntheticCatalogs: MTruyen-style list and unnamed chapter links
importantCases: Ignore first empty/menu match, ads, hidden text and dense links
Skip self, disabled, cross-book and foreign chapter navigation
Keep query-based book identity and original catalog URL
Do not read book summaries or other chapters from embedded JSON
Stop on invalid destinations and access challenges without fallback proxy requests
Keep legacy library association and book ID when merging catalogs

serverEvidence: All DNS records must be public; connections use pinned checked IPs
IPv4 preference and failover tested against an actual local HTTP fixture with simulated DNS/first-connection failure
Redirect, compressed size, method and URL checks retained
Charset meta fallback tested using Windows-1252 bytes

unverified.reason: Cloud HTTPS proxy rejected CONNECT with 403 before contacting the source; this is not an origin HTTP 403 or a confirmed cause of the deployed reader failure.
unverified.headlessSourceRendering: Not implemented. Only HTML/public embedded JSON is read; authenticated chapters and separate dynamic content APIs need dedicated integration.

cloudConfig: Added mtruyen.net to the existing draft allowlist; saving the draft does not apply/publish network settings.
